subject: RRP - Buy NOK Calls
body:
Buy NOK Calls

As discussed yesterday on the call, we like Nokia (NOK) Calls. Plus it has a $15 target from a sellside firm established recently.

Why?

1.Erlanger Put/Call 10 Day is elevated which we like for a long.

2.Erlanger Voulme Swing is positive.

When this stock gets hot, watch out.

Buy the NOK October 16 $10 Call for $0.79.
